name: agents-skills
description: A focused collection of reusable learning, documentation, product design, diagramming, and Git workflow skills.

interface.shortDescription: Six skills for learning, docs, design, diagrams, and Git
interface.longDescription: Build cognitive maps for learning, create accurate developer guides and READMEs, design buildable MVP briefs, generate editable Excalidraw architecture diagrams, and organize changes into clean Conventional Commits.
defaultPrompt: Use $cognitive-map to build a goal-oriented learning map for this topic.
Use $readme-writer to improve this repository's README.
Use $dev-guide to document this codebase's architecture.
Use $git-commit to organize these changes into clean commits.
